bug_type.name: CLI & UX
bug_type.description: Command line interface, argument parsing, and display issues

bugs.description: Cursor points to completed action: After completing a task with `prism task done`, the cursor still points to the completed action until `prism task start` is called.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Start task. 2. Finish task with 'prism task done'. 3. Observe cursor with 'prism status'.
bugs.root_cause: The cursor is simply not cleared in the TaskManager.complete_current_action() method. The proposed fix is a 'Sticky but Labeled' approach: keep the cursor but clarify status in the UI.

bug_type.name: CLI & UX
bug_type.description: Command line interface, argument parsing, and display issues

bugs.description: Bug type lookup inconsistent: BugManager.add_bug only accepts the bug type Name, not its Prefix. Should allow both for better UX.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Try adding a bug using its prefix (e.g. -t CLI). 2. Observe error saying bug type doesn't exist.
bugs.root_cause: ConfigManager.get_bug_type only checks the 'name' field. The fix is to check both 'name' and 'prefix' fields in the ConfigFile.bug_types list.

bug_type.name: CLI & UX
bug_type.description: Command line interface, argument parsing, and display issues

bugs.description: Orphan adopt parent path inconsistent: The `prism orphan adopt -p` option requires an absolute path without the leading `/` and should accept relative paths like other commands.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Go to a child level. 2. Try 'prism orphan adopt -p objective-slug'. 3. Observe failure.
bugs.root_cause: NavigationManager.get_item_by_path only supports absolute paths. The fix is to use resolve_path() within the core.add_item/adopt_orphan flow to allow relative paths.

bug_type.name: Core Logic
bug_type.description: Foundational business rules and task progression

bugs.description: Task progression crosses deliverable boundaries (Issue #4): `prism task next` does not respect deliverable boundaries when finding the next task. Finishing the last action in a deliverable immediately starts an action from the next deliverable context.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Complete all actions in deliverable A. 2. Run 'prism task next'. 3. Observe that it starts action in deliverable B.
bugs.root_cause: TaskManager._find_next_pending_action_in_objective iterates over all deliverables and returns the first pending action from ANY non-completed deliverable. It should instead signal that the deliverable is complete and wait for user input or the next start command.

bug_type.description: Command line interface, argument parsing, and display issues

bugs.description: CRUD status display enum representation: prism crud show displays the full ItemStatus enum repr (e.g., ItemStatus.PENDING) instead of just the value string (e.g., pending).
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Run 'prism crud show alpha'. 2. Observe the Status line.
bugs.root_cause: The _display_item function in prism/commands/crud.py doesn't access the .value property of the status enum. Fix is to use .value if it exists.

bug_type.name: Data & Persistence
bug_type.description: Storage, integrity, and Pydantic model consistency

bugs.description: Newly created strategic items are incorrectly treated as archived if they are not the 'first' active child, causing loading failures because they aren't actually in the archive.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Added a new strategic item (milestone) when the current focus milestone was incomplete. This caused the new item to be partially added to the parent's child_uuids but not persisted as active in strategic.json.
bugs.root_cause: CRUDManager.add_item was mutating the parent's child_uuids list (via parent.add_child) before all focus constraints were validated. If a later validation failed, the item was not saved to its type-specific file, but the parent's child-indexing was already updated.
bugs.fix_description: Implemented focus validation in CRUDManager.add_item before any tree mutation occurs. Simplified the CLI 'add' command by removing duplicate validation logic.
